extra.final_summary:
Penguins measured per island (51 rows used): Biscoe 21, Dream 25, Torgersen 5.

Problems found and fixed:
1. Island label variant — row 27 had " Biscoe" (leading space), which would have split Biscoe into two groups. Fixed with normalize_labels (" Biscoe" → "Biscoe"); island now has exactly the 3 allowed labels and no missing values.
2. Exact duplicate row — row 49 was an identical copy of an earlier row, which would have double-counted one penguin. Removed with drop_duplicates (approved).

Caveats (not changed, since they don't affect this question):
- body_mass_g is stored as text with 3 values written with thousands separators (e.g. "3,900"), and row 0 has an implausible value of 3,625,000 g (rules say 2500–6500 g) — likely a unit/typo error. Worth fixing if you later analyze body mass.
- sex has 3 missing values; per the rules these mean "unknown" and were left as-is.
- bill_depth_mm has no rule range defined, so it was not range-checked.
